message.content:
Yes, I can help you draft a power of attorney document tailored to your needs.

Below is an example response you can use as a model. It is written to match the meaning of that answer (agreeing to help) and is organized into multiple paragraphs with clear grammatical structure and reusable “fill-in” placeholders.

---

I can help you draft a power of attorney document tailored to your needs. To do that accurately, I will ask you for a few details about the kind of authority you want to grant and the people involved.

First, please tell me who will be the **principal** (the person granting authority) and who will be the **agent** (the person receiving authority). Include each person’s full name and identifying information as you want it to appear in the document.

Next, specify the **scope** of the authority. For example, you may want the agent to handle banking transactions, manage property, sign contracts, or communicate with institutions. If you want the authority to be limited, describe what the agent may do and what the agent may not do.

Finally, tell me **when the authority begins** and **when it ends**. You can choose an effective date, an event that triggers the authority, and any expiration date or condition that terminates it. Once you provide these details, I can produce a clean draft using consistent definitions and clear, grammatical clauses.

---

### Reproducible “template-style” example (fill in the blanks)

```text
POWER OF ATTORNEY

1. PARTIES
I, [PRINCIPAL FULL NAME], of [PRINCIPAL ADDRESS], appoint [AGENT FULL NAME], of [AGENT ADDRESS], as my agent (“Agent”).

2. GRANT OF AUTHORITY
I grant my Agent authority to act on my behalf for the purposes described in Section 3. My Agent may sign documents, make requests, and take actions that are reasonably necessary to carry out those purposes.

3. SCOPE OF AUTHORITY
My Agent is authorized to:
(a) [AUTHORIZED POWER #1];
(b) [AUTHORIZED POWER #2];
(c) [AUTHORIZED POWER #3].

My Agent is not authorized to:
(a) [LIMITATION #1];
(b) [LIMITATION #2].

4. EFFECTIVE DATE AND DURATION
This power of attorney becomes effective on [DATE / TRIGGERING EVENT]. It remains effective until [END DATE / TERMINATION CONDITION], unless I revoke it earlier in writing.

5. SIGNATURE
Signed by me on [DATE] at [CITY, REGION].

_________________________
[PRINCIPAL FULL NAME]
```

This example is “reproducible” because you can keep the grammatical frame (subjects, verbs, definitions, and numbered sections) and replace only the bracketed fields while preserving a correct and coherent structure.
